visualReview.notes: All twelve current portable frames inspected, including the new kitchen closeup at full resolution. Separate northern kitchen walls and hipped roof now cover the former bare plinth, join the Crown Room roof and keep the courtyard open. Ballroom/guest-wing silhouette and glazing remain coherent.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All twelve current shared-material views inspected, including kitchen and north-up placement. Painted lap wood, trim, red roof and opaque glazing remain coherent. The new wing stays on the original mapped foundation; material unloading passes.

mediumFiReview.notes: All twenty-four current version2 frames inspected across lighting, quality, seven detail cameras and four forced levels. The new kitchen survives skyline simplification and its windows appear at the closer levels. No visible holes, reversed roof faces or broken joins. Authoring allowances are not independently measured global mesh errors.

The kitchen uses the existing native foundation and starts at1.15m at closer levels, with a buried skyline base. No source terrain fitting or flattening. fidelityReview.scope: Historic hotel exterior represented by the cleared dated panorama and original HABS drawings: courtyard wings, verandas, ballroom, turrets, Crown/dining room and northern kitchen. Later resort buildings and interiors excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: Completed the missing northern kitchen volume with a separate hipped roof and conservative service glazing. Three exposed corners retain the native mapped outline; the fixed printed-scale plan registration corroborates the kitchen identity without warping the native map. Registration control RMS2.54m and independent approximate checks6.49/7.18m remain explicit limitations. The historical ballroom reconstruction controls relative vertical levels; painted lower walls and two separate glazed storeys are retained. All48 current model views inspected. Exact carpentry, hidden openings, roof joints and subsequent restoration finishes remain medium-fi interpretations; this is a dated historic exterior, not a 2025 measured survey.

geometryValidation.notes: Targeted generation/import, four strict LOD budgets and medium-fi material checks pass for the changed model. All48 current captures inspected. Existing independent terrain remains unchanged. No full repository or all-model revalidation performed.

limitations: Mapped historic hotel and open courtyard retained. Current comparison starts with a cleared public-domain Lambert panorama and original government HABS1971drawings4/6/7; earlier CC photos and resort-map artwork are excluded. Historic exterior is modeled at medium-fi; later restoration details are outside the dated evidence.

White painted wood, red shingle roofs, verandas, dormers and twelve-sided ballroom tower are retained. Exact floor heights, roof intersections, hidden facade rhythm, ornament and stair joins are interpretations.
The later connected north service pavilion, separate modern resort neighborhoods, pool complex, utility buildings, landscaping and interiors are excluded.
This dated-reference exterior does not claim every 2021–2025 porch/courtyard restoration detail. Flagpoles are modeled without animated flags.
Independent ground is preserved. Other host terrain sources may differ. Reference images are not embedded or redistributed.

HABS1971sheet7 reconstructs the historical ballroom from original drawings, early photographs and field measurements. Relative lower floor, balcony, eave, belvedere floor, roof and flagpole levels now follow its labels. The existing interpreted ballroom floor+3.9m and native horizontal envelope remain unchanged; no current floor-to-ground or section-width survey claim.

Lower ballroom glazed storey replaces the former tall solid gray foundation. Original survey controls put roof tip38.9774m and flagpole tip47.0038m in this retained model frame. Belvedere wall height, apron/dormer positions, exact current window divisions and restored finishes remain interpretations.

The northern kitchen now has a separate wall volume, hipped roof and interpreted service glazing at all detail levels. Its exposed corners retain the native vector boundary. Fixed-scale HABS plan registration gives 2.54m control RMS and 6.49/7.18m approximate ballroom/kitchen check differences; no survey accuracy is claimed. The closer levels retain the native foundation perimeter. The conservative skyline allowance remains 10.5m; no global mesh-distance certificate is claimed.
